items.title: 8.3 Designing Applications for Pakistan Using Emerging Technologies

source_refs.note: Topic 8.3 as printed: the text before its first sub-heading (PDF 115, printed 111).

blocks.text: Emerging technologies such as Artificial Intelligence (AI), the Internet of Things (IoT), Cloud Computing, and Blockchain offer new opportunities for solving Pakistan's pressing challenges (as shown in Figure 8.6). By combining innovation with local understanding, students can design applications that improve lives, enhance productivity, and support sustainable development. These technologies can transform sectors like healthcare, education, agriculture, and governance when used responsibly and creatively.

blocks.alt: A simplified map of Pakistan with its provinces in different colours: Balochistan, Sindh, Punjab, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and the northern areas, with a dashed line marked 'Frontier undefined' at the north-east end. Technology icons sit around the map: an AI chip and a doctor (health) to the north-west, an IoT cloud over the north, and to the east a cloud (cloud computing), an open book (education) and a network of connected blocks (blockchain).
blocks.caption: Figure 8.6: Emerging technologies can solve local challenges in Pakistan across key sectors like agriculture, health, and governance. (original drawing after the textbook's Figure 8.6)
blocks.long_description: The icons place emerging technologies (AI, IoT, cloud computing and blockchain) and the sectors they can help (such as health and education) around the map of Pakistan.
